purpose: Define the stable Level-6 Cross-Paper Intelligence analytical dimension catalogue without creating competing scientific owners, unsupported synthesis, or downstream Task-6 designs.
core_rule: An intelligence family is not a database field, and a dimension-catalogue entry is not a new ontology concept. L6 analytical dimensions reuse governed upstream meaning, evidence and multiplicity.

definitions.principal_cross_paper_dimension: A stable analytical axis with a distinct upstream semantic owner and unit/grain that can support reproducible single-dimension corpus analysis.
definitions.intelligence_family: A higher-order analytical family grouping one or more principal dimensions around a research question.
definitions.facet_nested_dimension: A subordinate analytical axis inside a principal dimension; it does not create a second scientific authority.

eligibility_modes.label: positive_scientific_aggregation
eligibility_modes.rule: Only eligible reviewed records under their controlling owner/evidence rules contribute positively.

eligibility_modes.label: coverage_state_reporting
eligibility_modes.rule: Missing, not-reported, unavailable, not-applicable and unresolved states remain visible where governed.

eligibility_modes.label: integrity_analytics
eligibility_modes.rule: Conflict, mismatch, ambiguity, negative and counterevidence remain analyzable as first-class states even when ineligible for positive aggregation.

analytical_rules.rule: Repeated statements or citations within one paper are not independent support.
Only eligible reviewed records enter positive scientific aggregation.
Contradictions, mismatch, ambiguity and negative/counterevidence remain visible.
Qualitative association is not an effect size and does not prove causality.
Every material aggregate must drill down to supporting paper, record and evidence identities as applicable.
Every aggregate must disclose numerator, denominator, unit of analysis, eligibility filter, scope and ontology/normalization version.
Paper count, record count, assignment count, result count, relation count, evidence count, collaboration-edge count and independent-study/PEU count are distinct.
A dimension-catalogue entry is coordination metadata and does not create a new scientific ontology owner.
L6 candidate signals cannot silently create official L7 gaps, opportunities or framework conclusions.
Claim, demonstration, contribution, outcome, validation and evaluation remain separate.
Physical problem, computational task and PINN challenge remain separate.
Demonstrated, related, potential and review-scoped application evidence remain separate.
Paper scientific relations, taxonomy hierarchy, bibliographic collaboration edges and L7 framework edges remain separate graph semantics.
Task 5.5 governs ontology promotion; frequent L6 patterns do not automatically promote schema, taxonomy, aliases or relations.

principal_dimensions.label: Temporal context
principal_dimensions.definition: Verified publication time plus explicitly labelled non-publication event dates/windows when analytically relevant; date semantics remain distinct.
upstream_owners: EXTRACTION_CONTROL dates when provenance analysis explicitly uses them
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Publication dates use verified bibliographic provenance; scientific/review dates retain their governing record and evidence where required.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use eligible papers for publication trends; use the relevant event-bearing subset for other date semantics and never pool date types.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: paper identity plus bibliographic/history or source record/evidence as applicable

principal_dimensions.label: Publication / source context
principal_dimensions.definition: Bibliographic venue/source, publication/reference type, document form and governed source context without substituting document labels for scientific study design.
allowed_groupings: publisher_article_label where source-local analysis is intended
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Use verified bibliographic provenance; do not infer scientific design from publisher labels.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Eligible bibliographically resolved papers for the selected attribute; unresolved/missing remains explicit.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: paper bibliographic identity and metadata verification/history

principal_dimensions.label: Study design / review scope
principal_dimensions.definition: Scientific study-design components and, where applicable, explicitly extracted review/synthesis scope without converting reviewed literature into current-paper primary-study evidence.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Scientific design/scope classifications must retain evidence and source-role rules; review scope is not primary-study demonstration.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Study-design analyses use eligible papers; review-scope analyses use only applicable review/synthesis records and declare that denominator.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: paper, study-design classification and review-scope evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Geographic provenance
principal_dimensions.definition: Bibliographically justified country/region provenance associated with papers/authors/institutions; geography is not an application domain.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Use authoritative bibliographic/affiliation provenance; do not infer location from application site unless specifically represented as such.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Declare paper-based versus association-based denominators; multi-country papers may contribute to multiple country associations without becoming multiple papers.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: paper and bibliographic affiliation/provenance chain

principal_dimensions.label: Institutional context
principal_dimensions.definition: Bibliographically justified institution/organization associations retained separately from geography and scientific methodology.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Use bibliographic affiliation provenance and identity resolution; do not infer institution from email domain alone when unresolved.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Declare paper versus institution-association denominator; preserve multi-affiliation multiplicity.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: paper and bibliographic institution association/history

principal_dimensions.label: Collaboration context
principal_dimensions.definition: Bibliographic co-authorship/institution/country collaboration structures represented as bibliographic network semantics, not scientific-method relations.
upstream_owners: PINN Realm/collaboration bibliographic projections where governed
allowed_groupings: network degree/community only as derived analytics
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Collaboration derives from verified bibliographic associations; network metrics are derived and retain source papers/edges.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Network statistics must state whether unit is papers, authors, institutions, countries or edges; no cross-unit denominator substitution.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: edge/entity to supporting paper and bibliographic associations

principal_dimensions.label: Application evidence role / scope
principal_dimensions.definition: Role of an application statement as demonstrated primary/secondary, related, potential/future or review-scoped, preserving evidence scope.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Retain explicit application-role evidence; never upgrade related/potential/review-discussed application into demonstration.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use application-bearing records or eligible papers under a named role; report multiple roles separately when a paper contains them.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: application item to paper and evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Application taxonomy
principal_dimensions.definition: Governed application domain/subdomain/specific-application hierarchy for appropriately scoped application records.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Taxonomy assignment must retain application role and supporting evidence; hierarchy does not erase source wording.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Declare whether counting papers or application assignments; a multi-domain paper remains one paper but multiple assignments.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: application taxonomy assignment to application record, paper and evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Physical system
principal_dimensions.definition: The physical/biological/engineered system being modelled or studied, kept separate from application hierarchy, governing equation and geography.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Require explicit source/evidence support; system identity cannot be inferred solely from equation family.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use eligible system-bearing application/problem records and separately report paper counts.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: system assignment to paper/application/problem/evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Physical problem
principal_dimensions.definition: The source-grounded physical/scientific problem studied, distinct from computational task and PINN-specific challenge.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Use verified problem evidence; do not infer problem identity from computational task or method name.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Eligible problem records or papers with verified problem records; disclose multiplicity if multiple problem components exist.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: problem record to paper and evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Governing equation / equation family
principal_dimensions.definition: Explicit governing equations and their governed/source-grounded families, preserving equation multiplicity and coupled systems.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Equation assignment requires source evidence; preserve raw equation wording/form and source scope where normalization is uncertain.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Distinguish equation-item counts, problem-record counts and paper counts; coupled equations do not create independent papers.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: equation/family item to problem record, paper and evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Problem class / characteristics
principal_dimensions.definition: Properties of the scientific problem such as dimensionality, scale, stiffness, discontinuity or complexity where explicitly supported, distinct from PINN failure/challenge.
allowed_groupings: multi-characteristic combinations only when explicitly selected
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Use verified evidence for each characteristic; source adjectives do not automatically map to canonical categories.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use eligible problem records/papers for selected characteristic; multiple characteristics remain multiple assignments.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: characteristic assignment to problem record, paper and evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Data / observation regime
principal_dimensions.definition: Structured observational/collocation/data conditions and explicit fidelity-source roles, coordinated without merging data regime, fidelity role or reproducibility availability.
upstream_owners: validation data source when explicitly selected for validation context
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Preserve owner-specific records and evidence; crosswalk only through explicit analytical facet labels.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use eligible structured records for selected facet and report paper counts separately; absence of data reporting is not zero data.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: structured data/fidelity record to paper/problem/method/evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Computational task / scientific objective
principal_dimensions.definition: What computational/scientific task is performed, with scientific objective preserved separately from the underlying physical problem.
allowed_groupings: engineering objective only when explicitly reported
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Require evidence for task/objective assignment; operator-learning or surrogate roles are classified by actual task, not model name alone.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Eligible task-bearing papers/records; disclose multiple task assignments within one paper.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: task/objective assignment to paper/problem/evidence

principal_dimensions.label: PINN problem / challenge addressed
principal_dimensions.definition: PINN-specific methodological/problem challenge the study explicitly addresses, kept separate from the physical problem, problem characteristic and observed diagnostic failure.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Challenge assignment must be explicitly supported; design intent does not prove successful resolution.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Eligible challenge assignments or papers with verified challenge assignments; report both if relevant.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: challenge assignment to paper and evidence

principal_dimensions.label: PINN type / family
principal_dimensions.definition: Evidence-scoped PINN type/family assignment using Task 4 taxonomy, collision and source-scope controls.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Assignment requires eligible evidence; raw acronym/name occurrence alone is not a verified type assignment.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use eligible type assignments and separately report unique paper counts; one paper may have multiple scoped types.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: type assignment to paper, raw terminology, evidence and taxonomy decision

principal_dimensions.label: Methodology
principal_dimensions.definition: Composite analytical parent over governed methodology owner dimensions and Task-5 faceted coordination layers; not a generic scientific field or pooled method count.
upstream_owners: Task 5.2 LIT-F1..LIT-F4 and derived query facets
Task 5.2C EX-01..EX-15 according to Task 5.4 dispositions
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Each child dimension retains its own owner, evidence, scope and applicability. No inference from method-name occurrence or neighboring facet.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Each child method dimension has its own eligible denominator. A single pooled methodology denominator/frequency is prohibited unless an explicitly defined query states the union semantics.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: selected child method assignment/record to paper, evidence, taxonomy/relation state and owner

principal_dimensions.label: Contribution / innovation
principal_dimensions.definition: Author-supported contribution and innovation records, separate from demonstrated outcomes or performance superiority.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Retain evidence/source origin; author claim of novelty is not independently validated superiority.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Eligible contribution records/papers; multiple contribution types remain multiple classifications.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: contribution record to paper/evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Claim vs demonstration
principal_dimensions.definition: Explicit separation between what a study claims and what it actually demonstrates, including mismatch or limited-support states.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Claims and demonstrations require separate evidence paths when materially distinct; preserve disagreement.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Eligible claim/demonstration-bearing records; missing demonstration is not automatically a failed claim unless evidence supports that interpretation.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: claim and demonstration records/statements to evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Generality / transfer scope
principal_dimensions.definition: Scope of generality, transferability or cross-context applicability claimed and evidenced, retaining author claim versus demonstrated generalization.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Do not infer generalization from multiple training/test cases unless the source/test design supports it.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use eligible generality-bearing records; tested-generalization denominator is only the subset where such testing is applicable/reported.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: generality claim/test to paper, validation context and evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Outcome / degree of resolution
principal_dimensions.definition: Study outcome and degree to which the stated problem/objective is resolved, distinct from contribution and isolated metric values.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Outcome aggregation uses verified source evidence and retains scope/test conditions; do not infer from training loss alone.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Eligible outcome records/papers; multiple scoped outcomes must not be collapsed into one success label.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: outcome record to paper and evidence/evaluation support

principal_dimensions.label: Reported advantage / disadvantage / failure
principal_dimensions.definition: Source-reported advantages, disadvantages and failure cases attached to scoped outcomes, distinct from causal diagnosis or Atlas framework conclusions.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Use direct source-grounded statements; failure statement does not establish cause/mechanism unless separately evidenced.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use eligible statement records and report paper counts separately; silence is not absence of disadvantage/failure.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: statement to outcome/paper/evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Validation strategy
principal_dimensions.definition: How the study validates the model/result, including analytical, numerical, experimental, real-world and other governed validation modes.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Validation classifications require evidence and applicable-state control; not reported is not performed.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use applicable validation records/papers and expose not-reported/not-applicable states where governed.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: validation record to paper and evidence/reference source

principal_dimensions.label: Validation reference / data / baseline
principal_dimensions.definition: The reference solution, validation data source or baseline method against which a study is validated/compared, retaining role and scope.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Reference/baseline role must be explicit; software used for validation is not automatically solver coupling methodology.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use eligible validation/evaluation context records; baseline count is not paper count.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: reference/baseline item to validation/evaluation record, paper and evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Evaluation metric
principal_dimensions.definition: Identity and governed definition of metrics used to evaluate model/results, separate from metric values and test cases.
upstream_owners: Performance Metrics governed registry/definitions where authoritative projection exists
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Metric identity/definition must be traceable; lexical similarity does not justify merging metrics with different definitions/scales.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Count eligible evaluation-result observations using the metric and separately report unique papers/test cases; never average across incompatible metric definitions.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: metric occurrence to evaluation result, paper, conditions and evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Evaluation result / test case
principal_dimensions.definition: Repeatable evaluated observation containing value, baseline value, test case, conditions, reference solution and comparison context.
allowed_groupings: result direction only when definition permits
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Each material result retains context/evidence; materially different test cases are not collapsed.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Result-observation denominator is distinct from paper denominator; pooled statistics require metric/scale/test-context compatibility that later tasks must explicitly establish.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: result observation to paper, metric, test case, conditions and evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Reproducibility availability
principal_dimensions.definition: Availability/reporting states for code, data and model artifacts, preserving not-reported versus reported-unavailable versus available.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Use explicit reported/verified states; do not convert missing URL to reported unavailable without evidence.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Applicable paper reproducibility records; report not-reported separately rather than dropping it.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: reproducibility state to paper/source evidence or verified resource record

principal_dimensions.label: Reproducibility reporting / computational context
principal_dimensions.definition: Reporting state for hyperparameters, random seed, hardware, training cost and related computational reproducibility context.
allowed_groupings: combined completeness only if explicitly defined as derived score
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Preserve explicit reporting states and evidence; missing cost is not zero cost.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Applicable paper reproducibility records; each subattribute keeps its own reporting-state denominator if applicability differs.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: reporting state to paper/evidence/configuration context

principal_dimensions.label: Limitation
principal_dimensions.definition: Repeatable source-grounded study limitation with category, scope, origin, evidence and verification retained.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Every synthesis-eligible limitation requires traceable evidence; inference remains labelled separately from author statement.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Count limitation records and unique supporting papers separately; multiple limitations in one paper are not independent papers.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: limitation to paper/evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Open problem
principal_dimensions.definition: Repeatable unresolved scientific/methodological issue explicitly represented as an open problem, with source/Atlas origin and persistence scope retained.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Author-stated and Atlas-inferred open problems remain distinct; Atlas inference requires governed synthesis evidence.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Count open-problem records and unique independent papers separately; recurrence must not use repeated mentions as independent support.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: open-problem record to paper/evidence/synthesis origin

principal_dimensions.label: Future work
principal_dimensions.definition: Repeatable source-grounded proposed future direction, separate from current demonstration and from an unresolved open problem unless evidence explicitly supports both roles.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Future work must be directly evidenced or clearly labelled Atlas inference; proposed future activity is not current demonstration.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Count future-work records and supporting papers separately; repeated bullets/sentences within one paper are not independent studies.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: future-work record to paper/evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Failure / diagnostic pathway
principal_dimensions.definition: Evidence-scoped diagnostic pathway components and relations among symptom, cause/mechanism, check/analysis, intervention, targeted improvement, verification and trade-off.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Each typed component/relation retains evidence and direction; intervention or intended target is not verified improvement.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: State whether counting papers, pathways, components or typed edges; do not treat multiple pathway components as independent papers.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: pathway/component/relation to paper and evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Evidence provenance / source role
principal_dimensions.definition: Evidence origin, category, type, source role and locator characteristics used to audit what kind of source supports scientific records.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Evidence objects are themselves provenance records; their content/locator remains immutable under the evidence protocol except governed correction history.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use eligible evidence objects for evidence-object analytics and separately report linked papers/records; evidence count is never paper count.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: evidence object to verbatim text, locator, paper and linked record

principal_dimensions.label: Evidence verification / support / strength
principal_dimensions.definition: Separate verification status, semantic support status and statement/evidence strength attributes; no single opaque quality score is created.
allowed_groupings: source role cross-tab only with denominator clarity
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Verification and semantic support remain distinct; partial support must narrow the claimed scope rather than count as full support.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Evidence-record denominator for selected facet; independent-support statements additionally require study-family/PEU logic where recurrence is claimed.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: state to evidence object, linked scientific record and verification history

principal_dimensions.label: Contradiction / mismatch / ambiguity
principal_dimensions.definition: First-class analytical dimension for conflicting, mismatched, ambiguous or unresolved scientific/evidence states, including within-paper and cross-paper conflict scope.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Conflicting evidence is preserved; analytics may describe disagreement but cannot silently choose a winner without governed review.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use conflict/evidence units appropriate to the analysis and disclose affected-paper count separately; absence of detected conflict is not proof of consensus.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: conflict group/state to all supporting and counterevidence records

principal_dimensions.label: Typed scientific relationship
principal_dimensions.definition: Evidence-scoped directed relations connecting governed scientific records/concepts, with relation lifecycle/status preserved.
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: A positive relation requires evidence for the relation itself; co-occurrence is insufficient and context-sensitive claims remain scoped.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Relation-edge denominator differs from source/target entity and paper denominators; report each explicitly.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: relation instance to source/target records, paper and supporting/counterevidence

principal_dimensions.label: Atlas research gap
principal_dimensions.definition: Governed curated Atlas research-gap synthesis object supported by traceable multi-source evidence; L6 may analyze approved objects but cannot auto-create them.
upstream_owners: L7 Atlas Research Gap synthesis owner
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Only governed L7 gap objects count as official gaps; L6 recurrence/candidate signals remain candidates until curated review.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use approved gap objects for gap-object analysis and independent supporting papers/PEUs for support descriptions; keep them separate.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: gap object to supporting/counterevidence papers, records and evidence

principal_dimensions.label: Atlas research opportunity
principal_dimensions.definition: Governed curated Atlas research-opportunity synthesis object supported by traceable evidence and rationale; L6 may analyze approved objects but cannot auto-create them.
upstream_owners: L7 Atlas Research Opportunity synthesis owner
principal_dimensions.evidence_rule: Only governed L7 opportunity objects count as official opportunities; future-work recurrence or algorithmic signals do not auto-promote.
principal_dimensions.denominator_rule: Use approved opportunity objects for object analysis and independent supporting papers/PEUs for support descriptions; keep them separate.
principal_dimensions.drilldown: opportunity object to supporting/counterevidence papers, records and evidence

methodology_nested_catalogue.rule: Methodology is a composite analytical parent. Child dimensions retain their existing owners and denominators; no generic stored methodology or learning_type field is created.

requirements: separate paper count from record/event/relation counts
do not pool incompatible numerical metrics, scales, definitions, test cases or conditions
separate raw occurrence from independent scientific support

downstream_handoffs.task_6_2: Define one complete single-dimension explorer for each XPD-01..XPD-38, with XPD-17 exposing owner-preserving child dimensions rather than pooled methodology frequency.
downstream_handoffs.task_6_3: Implement/specify the frozen 20 intelligence families using the dimension-to-family map while preserving family != dimension.
downstream_handoffs.task_6_4: Define scientifically meaningful cross-dimensional comparison choices after individual dimensions/explorers are stable.
downstream_handoffs.task_6_6: Serialize the comparison-choice map in version-controlled form.
downstream_handoffs.task_6_7: Design the comparison/explorer UI without page-local scientific authority.

stop_boundary: Task 6.1 defines the dimension catalogue only. Task 6.2 has not started.
